Briefing for 21 November 2026

Short items for 21 November 2026. Sapaude writes them in its own words. Where a longer article exists, the link goes there. The publisher is Sapaude.

Study

Mathematician claims Riemann proof made with Claude

An Anthropic mathematician says he proved the Riemann hypothesis with help from Claude and formalized it in Lean. The claim has not been independently verified, and Anthropic has not commented.

Source: The Verge

AI agents

Claude can now use desktop apps in Team plans

Computer use is now in beta for Claude Team and Enterprise plans. Claude can see the screen and work in desktop apps that users allow, and the feature is rolling out to organizations gradually.

Source: Anthropic

Everyday tool

Signal stops AI assistants from reading your chats

Signal now blocks screenshots and on-device assistants like Gemini and Siri from reading its screen. On iPhone the protection is on by default, and it can be adjusted in the privacy settings.

Source: Signal

AI agents

Google tests its agents on a fake internet

Google built a sealed-off test web with thousands of artificial websites to expose its AI agents to realistic attacks. The goal is to find prompt injection weaknesses without agents taking real actions online.

Source: heise online

In the background · More technical

OpenAI tightens defenses against model copying

OpenAI explains how it detects attempts to train rival models on its outputs without permission. In internal tests, attacks to extract hidden reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra succeeded only 0.2% of the time.

Source: OpenAI

Study

New benchmark tests AI on drug discovery tasks

OpenAI's MedChemBench has 99 problems from medicinal chemistry research, such as choosing which compounds to test next. GPT-6.2 Astra scored 84.5% of the available credit.

Source: OpenAI

In the background

Trump threatens tax on AI data centers abroad

President Trump said US tech firms that build AI data centers in other countries will face a heavy tax. He gave no details and said his own officials had not yet been told about the plan.

Source: AP News

Device

Meta rethinks its 2030 climate goal as AI grows

Meta is reevaluating its goal of net-zero emissions by 2030. Its new sustainability report shows total emissions rose almost 40% in 2025, as AI data center demand grew faster than planned.

Source: Ars Technica
